Section 8-35 Replacement of Wireless LAN Option
NOTE: Before replacing or installing the WLAN device, please confirm that the new part is compatible with the software on the system.
Refer to Section 9-15 "LOGIQ S8/LOGIQ E8 Master FRU List Compatibility Chart" on page 9-66 .
Of course you must indicate in that chart the dependency of the WLAN with the base load part number.
NOTE: The wireless dongle replacement procedure is different on R1-R3 to R4.
Section 8-35 - Replacement of Wireless LAN Option 8 - 297
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual

Insert the Wireless LAN into a USB port. Set the Wireless LAN in place with two screws (M4 PAN HAED SCREW) which unscrew Procedure 2. If "Self adhesive hook & loop" is not attached on the Wireless LAN model, attach it according to WLAN option Installation Instruction.
Route the Gel warmer cable between the front cover and the OPIO, as shown.
Be careful not to pinch the gel warmer cable when closing the front cover.
Tighten one screw at the front cover that attach the cover to the system. Tighten securely.
8 - 298 Section 8-35 - Replacement of Wireless LAN Option
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
1.) Attach loop sheet on Wireless LAN dongle. Refer to below figure. (5499363, SELF ADHESIVE HOOK AND LOOP W30XL75).

Configure as required by the site IT department.

Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
NOTE: TCP/IP... button does not exist on R2 and WLAN always works with DHCP. Static IP, Subnet Mask and Default Gateway for WLAN are not able to be set.
Section 8-35 - Replacement of Wireless LAN Option 8 - 303
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
When the WLAN is active, an icon appears in the status bar to indicate whether the WLAN is active or not active.
Select Utility -> Connectivity -> TCP/IP -> Wireless Network -> Configuration .
If enabled, Available Wireless Networks appear.
Highlight the wireless network you want to use.
Click Connect at the bottom of the "Configuration" tool.
If unable to connect, select Diagnostics tab, Run Diagnostics. For more information, see the latest revision of the LOGIQ™ S8 Basic User Manual, Chapter 16.
Check that the WLAN is working properly; ping/ verify a device in the network, query WL or Send an image.
Perform Functional Checks. See: 8-35-6-2 - Calibration and adjustments , 8-35-6-3 - Verification and 8-35-6-4 "Functional Test" on page 8-305 .
8 - 304 Section 8-35 - Replacement of Wireless LAN Option
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
No calibrations or adjustments are needed after this part replacement.
Perform the following steps to verify that the product is functioning as intended after this replacement:
1.) Verify that the screw that you removed earlier has been installed.
2.) If finished, connect cables and Probes removed earlier.
3.) Power up the system to verify that it operates as intended.
Perform the following functional checks to confirm the system is operational before returning the system to the customer.
If all are successful, include the following debrief script: LOGIQ S8 Proprietary Service Manual, Direction 5394227, 10. Equipment passed all required checks and is ready for use.
Table 8-68 WLAN installation instructions Functional Checks
Section 8-35 - Replacement of Wireless LAN Option 8 - 305
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual

Running diagnostics is good if you think the adapter might be bad. Diagnostics also tell you if the connection is behaving properly. Sometimes the scanner connects by accident to the DVR or another internal device which uses the TCP/IP protocol. The diagnostics would show if there are errors when performing the full two-way communication. For example, if the IP address starts with 197 or 169 (loopback addresses), then something is wrong.
To run diagnostics for the Wireless Network,
1.) Press Utility--> Connectivity--> TCP/IP--> Wireless Network--> Configuration. The Wireless Network Configuration tool appears. Available Wireless Networks appear.
8 - 306 Section 8-35 - Replacement of Wireless LAN Option
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
Occasionally you may need to repair a WLAN that has lost its connection to the LOGIQ S8. To repair the Wireless Network,
1.) Press Utility--> Connectivity--> TCP/IP--> Wireless Network--> Configuration. The Wireless Network Configuration tool appears. Available Wireless Networks appear.
NOTE: DO NOT cancel the Repair operation after you have selected to repair the Wireless LAN connection.
If the WLAN is functioning properly, the following message appears. Confirm your decision to repair (Yes), or cancel (No).

The available WLAN channels show availability of wireless connect points that the scanner can talk to. Each channel supports a finite number of users and has limited signal strength. This may affect the ability to connect, the throughput and the connection dropping out.
To check the available WLAN channels,
1.) Press Utility--> Connectivity--> TCP/IP--> Wireless Network--> Configuration. The Wireless Network Configuration tool appears. Available Wireless Networks appear.
2.) Select the Properties Tab and Available Channels... .
Section 8-35 - Replacement of Wireless LAN Option 8 - 307
Direction 5394227, 13 LOGIQ S8/E8/S7 XDclear2.0 Service Manual
Figure 8-154 Available Wireless Network Channels list
To disconnect from the Wireless Network,
1.) Press Utility--> Connectivity--> TCP/IP--> Wireless Network--> Configuration. The Wireless Network Configuration tool appears.
2.) Select the WLAN you are connected to.
2.) Select DIAGNOSTICS - Service Diagnostics > PC > Network Adapter > Wireless Network adapter test.
